nodes.name: Load Calibration Cases
nodes.notes: Generated from tests/fixtures/semantic-calibration-cases.json. Rebuild this workflow after changing the dataset.

nodes.name: Build Semantic Lookup Input
nodes.notes: Constructs a fresh allowlisted object containing only context. Calibration labels and notes never enter the production semantic lookup.

nodes.name: Loop Over Calibration Cases
nodes.notes: Processes one case at a time to preserve deterministic correlation and avoid provider concurrency spikes.

nodes.name: Execute Semantic Pattern Lookup V1
nodes.notes: After import, select Semantic Pattern Lookup V1. One synthetic calibration case produces one normalized lookup result.

nodes.name: Reattach Calibration Correlation
nodes.notes: Reattaches only case_id after the strict production sub-workflow returns. Evaluation labels remain in Load Calibration Cases.

parameters.content:
## Phase 5D-D calibration harness
Runs the synthetic repository dataset through Semantic Pattern Lookup V1. Export the single normalized output as `tests/results/semantic-calibration-raw.json`, then run `node scripts/run-semantic-calibration.js`. No webhook, database write, Main integration, scoring, or threshold is present.
